## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and does one thing.
- [ ] I ran the checks in [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/LeulAria/volt/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#checks-before-you-push) and added or updated tests.
- [ ] UI changes were tried in the running app and look right in light and dark themes.
- [ ] I read everything an AI tool wrote for this change, and I understand it.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has a line for anything a user would notice.
